feature: DMG Synth VGM channel On/Off software monitor

scope.default: All four On; available before loading/audio creation.
scope.signal: Output-only mask on the separate reference APU. No queue clearing, replay/reseek, register writes, retrigger or source-position changes.
scope.timing: Already queued/rendered PCM retains its original mix and drains normally; newly generated samples use the latest mask, including after Resume.
scope.lifecycle: Flags persist in this page session across Stop, source changes and seek; latest settings reach asynchronously created engines and seek candidates.
scope.isolation: Live observation, paused keyboard audition, editable Synth, Code, captured JSON and source VGM bytes keep their original settings. Flags are not serialized.

actualWasm: All 16 channel combinations match an independent direct-APU oracle exactly, with bounded Float32 rounding for solo-channel sums.
All Off produces exact zero samples; native Envelope/Sweep/oscillator/Noise history continues and unmute matches uninterrupted native PCM.
Already queued samples keep the previous mix; full → zero → solo changes occur at subsequently generated native-frame boundaries.
Seek uses the latest mask and exact original register/Wave RAM snapshots; Stop/source changes retain the chosen mask.
Author APU registers, native phase, next-note PCM and keyboard/Code lease ownership remain untouched by the reference monitor.
additionalCoverage: Strict index/boolean validation and detached read arrays; passive toggles before source or AudioContext.
No AudioBuffer identity, transport phase, Live freeze or Capture transaction changes on a toggle.
Keyboard Space/Enter state and pointer focus; software-muted voices remain capturable, including during an in-flight Capture.

baseline.coverage: Existing keyboard, Wave drawing, chip controls, preset/VGM/VGZ import, Pitch, volume and context recovery.

visualReview: Chromium 1240px: compact four-switch row between transport and Live selection, with explicit software mute label.
WebKit 390px: all four On/Off switches stay visible and fit without horizontal overflow.
limits: Mute reaches the listener after the short pre-rendered audio buffer; it is not a zero-latency edit of already generated PCM.
These are reference-song monitor controls; keyboard audition deliberately remains audible even for an Off channel.
Channel volume, Solo, persistent mixer presets and extra APU voices are outside this change.
